    • Family: They have one daughter, Lily Dolores Harris, born in 1993.

      Evidence of Smoking:
      • 2001 Interviews: He was noted for smoking unfiltered cigarettes, linking the habit to his intense nature and preparation for playing Jackson Pollock, as reported by The Washington Post and SFGATE. 
      • Photos: Images from the early 2000s and even 2014 show him smoking. 
      Attempts to Quit: 
      • A 2008 article mentioned his use of nicotine lozenges as a substitute for cigarettes, showing a pattern of trying to break the habit.
      While these sources primarily focus on the early to mid-2000s, they confirm smoking as a significant habit for him during that period.
